title: Compact provenance telemetry for region/tier/fallback policy resolution
creator: Asha Patel
description: Add a compact, single-line provenance telemetry format and minimal per-hop metrics for the policy resolver that decides region selection, customer tier routing, and fallback model variant resolution. Goal: make every decision traceable end-to-end with low cardinality fields suitable for high-volume ingestion (events per token request), and provide drill-down queries that link SLO violations to policy inputs (region, tier, model_variant, reason).
acceptance_criteria: 1) Each resolved request emits a single provenance event (protobuf->json compact) that contains: correlation_id, timestamp, resolver_version, final_region, selected_tier, model_variant_tag, fallback_reason_code (if any), upstream_latencies_ms (comma-separated), and sample_rate_tag.

2) Per-hop counters: resolver.invocations, resolver.fallbacks, resolver.fallback_by_reason, resolver.region_routed_count (by region), resolver.tier_mismatch_count. Metrics must be emitted to Prometheus/StatsD and appear on the Console dashboard.
3) Span-level trace enrichment: the policy resolver span must include stable tags for model_variant_tag and final_region; traces should be linkable to the provenance event via correlation_id.

4) Ingest cost and cardinality: average provenance event size must be < 1.2KB and high-cardinality fields limited to explicit enumerated tags. Verify with synthetic load test (100k requests/min) and show <5% telemetry ingestion error rate.
5) Queryable dashboards and alerts: Console must show a per-region fallback rate panel and an alert when fallback_rate > 0.5% over 5m for any customer tier.
6) Backfill: historical samples for last 7 days should be resolvable for incidents using existing trace/provenance storage (linking by correlation_id).
design_notes: We intentionally avoid dumping full resolver input (prompt, headers) into provenance events to reduce cardinality and PII exposure. The design keeps only enumerated tags and short hashes for heavy inputs.

Compact field encoding: use snake_case short names (cid, rv, rg, t, mv, fr) to reduce payload size; upstream_latencies_ms stored as a short CSV field (e.g., 12,3) representing [policy_eval_ms,kernel_lookup_ms].

Sampling: default sample_rate 1% for full event body; sampled events include a context blob (100-300 bytes). Every request emits a light-weight metric/counter; only sampled requests produce the full provenance event. Sample rate configurable by org and overridable for investigations.

Trade-offs considered: 1) Full request logging gives easier debugging but high cost; 2) Only metrics are low-cost but insufficient for root cause. We chose a hybrid approach (light metrics always + sampled lightweight events) to balance cost and debuggability.

Security: provenance events exclude prompt text and user identifiers. For privacy-sensitive customers, the private deployment will run with sample_rate=0 and route full events to customer-controlled storage when requested.
Schema versioning: include resolver_version (rv) and schema_version (sv) fields to allow future field additions without breaking parsers.
implementation_plan: 1) Add compact provenance emitter in policy-resolver module (C++, runtime) with a concise JSON serializer. Create feature flag 'compact_provenance_v1'.
2) Expose new Prometheus metrics from resolver: resolver_invocations_total{region,tier}, resolver_fallbacks_total{region,tier,reason}, resolver_latency_ms_bucket (histogram).
3) Enrich OpenTelemetry spans with tags: 'mv' (model_variant_tag), 'rg' (final_region), 'tier'. Ensure correlation_id is set and propagated to tracing and provenance event.
4) Create ingestion pipeline mapping for provenance events in EventBridge -> Kinesis -> compact-json-indexer. Implement cardinality checks and field whitelist at the indexer.
5) Build Console panels and alert rule: fallback_rate by region/tier, fallback reasons breakout, and per-variant SLO impact graph.

6) Add end-to-end tests: unit tests for serializer, integration test emitting events to dev ingestion pipeline, and load test at 100k req/min with default sample_rate to validate size/ingestion errors.
7) Create a migration path for older provenance formats using schema_version in the indexer.
rollout_plan: Phase A - Canary (internal): enable compact_provenance_v1 for internal orgs only; sample_rate 5%; monitor ingestion errors and event size distribution for 48h.
Phase B - Limited customers: enable for 10% of paid orgs; sample_rate 1%; collect feedback from SRE and two pilot customers on dashboard utility.
Phase C - Default opt-in: enable metrics-only path and 0.1% sampled events for all; provide org-level toggle in Console for higher sample rates.
Rollback criteria: >1% telemetry ingestion errors, or >10% increase in tail request latency attributable to provenance emission (verified by tracing).
monitoring_queries: PromQL: sum(rate(resolver_fallbacks_total[5m])) by (region, tier) / sum(rate(resolver_invocations_total[5m])) by (region, tier) -> yields fallback_rate_by_region_tier
Elasticsearch: GET /_search {query: {term: {cid: "<correlation-id>"}}} -> used during incident investigations to fetch provenance event for a request (index: provenance-compact-*)
KQL (Console): provenance_event.sv:1 and provenance_event.rv:>=1 and final_region:us-west-2 -> show sampled events for resolver_version >=1
Trace linking: find span where attr['cid'] == provenance_event.cid and span.name == 'policy-resolver.resolve' -> link trace to provenance event
comments: 2025-01-12 - Asha Patel: Initial draft posted. Key open question: do we want sampled_context to include a 64-bit hash of the prompt for deduping? My recommendation: yes, include prompt_hash (not the text).
2025-01-15 - Luca Romano: Implemented initial serializer in branch feat/compact-provenance. Benchmarked payload sizes: median 560B, 95th 980B. Pushed a WIP PR for early review.
2025-01-18 - Priya Mehta (SRE): Observability notes - need a guardrail for cardinality explosion from model_variant_tag free-form strings; recommend enumerating tags in model onboarding pipeline.
2025-01-21 - Design review (Tom Nguyen): UI panels look good; request for an example drilldown link from fallback alert to a set of correlated traces/events.
2025-01-27 - Luca Romano: Integration tests pass in staging. Ingestion indexer added a whitelist of fields to prevent accidental high-cardinality values. Sample_rate default set to 0.5% in staging.
2025-02-02 - Asha Patel: Load test executed at 120k req/min; ingestion errors observed 0.9% (under threshold). Plan to bump sample_rate to 1% for canary and monitor storage cost estimates.
Next steps: finalize PR, add alert rule for fallback_rate > 0.5%, coordinate with Console team for panel rollout in runtime-1.20 release.
